test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six children, G, H, I, J, K, and L, are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. J and K are sitting to the immediate left and right of G, respectively. L is sitting to the immediate left of J, but not to the immediate right of H. Who is sitting to the immediate right of K?
solution:
**Six Children: **G, H, I, J, K, and L, are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre

1) J and K are sitting to the immediate left and right of G, respectively. L is sitting to the immediate left of J, but not to the immediate right of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/406ca397467ecb59cc787b72978231da2b95d87af6762ea1ef23f8694688baad.png] 

Clearly, H is sitting immediate right of K.

Hence, the correct answer is **"H".**
